jobs.title: Implement P2 protection top-ups (test-only + pyproject mypy removal)
jobs.objective: Land the five P2 items from the 2026-06-06 remediation plan, one commit per item, in this order. This batch is TEST-ONLY plus one pyproject edit: the entire kayakgen/ package tree, scripts/, and all non-listed docs are FORBIDDEN — if a test you write exposes a product bug, record it in the draft artifact as a successor finding (cite the audit/bug-hunt convention) instead of fixing product code here. ITEM 1 (P2-HYDRO-ANCHOR, audit R7): in tests/test_hydrostatics.py add one analytic cross-check — configure a Hull as close to a wall-sided prismatic form as the parametrization allows and assert displaced volume and LCB against the closed-form value at coarse tolerance (rtol on the order of 1e-2), documenting the geometric idealization and the chosen tolerance in the test comment; the goal is an EXTERNAL anchor, not a tighter self-pin — if the parametrization cannot get within honest reach of the analytic body, document why and pin the scaling-law property family tighter instead (state which path you took and why in the draft artifact). ITEM 2 (P2-CANCEL-DETERMINISTIC, audit R8): in tests/test_generative_jobs_subprocess.py add a manager-level cancel test that exercises the cancel path DETERMINISTICALLY using the existing _controlled_cancel_runner monkeypatch pattern, so cancel assertions run unconditionally in the default suite; then demote the racy variant: replace its mid-race pytest.skip outs with a clear comment that the deterministic test owns the contract and the racy one is integration smoke (keep it, but its disjunctive final assertion may remain — document that it is smoke, not the gate). ITEM 3 (P2-REGISTRY-MICROGAPS, audit R10): in tests/test_stability_fit_registry.py add exactly three tests: (a) a fit citing TWO fixtures where only the second clears the full chain — pins the ANY-pass semantics of _evaluate_fit_gates; (b) a hysteresis bound_fraction=0.031 rejection — pins the second branch of gate 3a (REASON_FIXTURE_BOUNDS_TOO_LOOSE via hysteresis, not drift); (c) a touching heel-range load (fit (30,60) vs fixture (0,30)) — pins the <= overlap boundary of gate 9 as intended-pass. The existing test_fixture_canonical_sha256_digest pin test (0063) must remain byte-identical. ITEM 4 (P2-REASON-ENUM, audit §5 note): rewrite test_every_reason_has_a_next_action to derive the expected reason-code set from the registry module namespace (vars(reg), keys starting REASON_ excluding REASON_NEXT_ACTION) so a future gate constant cannot ship without operator remediation copy. ITEM 5 (P2-MYPY-DECIDE, audit §3 note): remove mypy from the [dev] optional-dependency extras in pyproject.toml (the plan's recommendation: never configured, never gated, ruff is established) and add a CHANGELOG entry noting the removal rationale; do NOT add mypy config. GATE: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -> 0 failed, exactly the 4 documented OpenFOAM skips; .venv/bin/python -m ruff check kayakgen tests -> clean. Heartbeat around the ~9-minute run. Publish DRAFT.md: per-item shas + diffstat, which P2-HYDRO-ANCHOR path was taken and the analytic derivation, the deterministic-cancel evidence, the three micro-gap test names, the reason-enum derivation, and the full-gate tail.

jobs.title: Review P2 top-ups for assertion honesty and gate integrity
jobs.objective: Review the five P2 items. (2) The hydrostatics anchor is an honest external check: the analytic derivation in the comment is correct (recompute it yourself), the tolerance is justified, and the test would actually fail if volume integration drifted by more than the tolerance; if the author took the documented fallback path (tighter property pins), check the justification holds. (3) The deterministic cancel test exercises the real cancel contract via the controlled runner without wall-clock races; the racy variant is clearly demoted to smoke. (4) The three registry micro-gap tests pin what they claim (ANY-pass via second fixture, hysteresis-branch rejection code, touching-range pass) and the 0063 digest pin is byte-identical. (5) The reason-enum test now derives from the module namespace — verify by mentally adding a REASON_X constant: would it fail? (6) mypy removed from [dev] extras only; no config added; CHANGELOG notes it. (7) Run the FULL gate yourself (0 failed / exactly 4 documented skips; ruff clean); findings file BEFORE the long run; heartbeat around it. Verdicts: accept / accept_with_findings for apply-fixable issues; needs_revision for scope violations or a red gate; NEVER terminal reject.
